File: docs/CONFIG.md

The configuration documentation does not adequately inform users to set the S3_ENDPOINT environment variable when using MinIO.

label: docs
file: docs/CONFIG.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The configuration documentation does not adequately inform users to set the S3_ENDPOINT environment variable when using MinIO.
